slot.brief: A charged particle enters a uniform magnetic field at an oblique angle; high-rigour MCQ combining pitch (v∥T), radius (v⊥) and time period — e.g. find the pitch-to-radius ratio or the condition for the particle to re-enter at a specific point.

stem: A charged particle moves helically in a uniform magnetic field, with its initial velocity making an angle $\theta$ with the field. After two complete revolutions, its axial displacement equals the circumference of its circular projection. Find $\theta$.

verdicts.working: Cyclotron period is T=2π/ω. In two revolutions, axial displacement is 2v cosθ·T; the projected circle’s circumference is 2πv sinθ/ω. Equating gives tanθ=2, hence θ=tan⁻¹(2).
issues: The angle range is unspecified; if axial displacement is interpreted as a distance, the supplementary angle also satisfies the condition, though it is not among the options.

working:
$p=v_{\parallel}T,\quad r=\dfrac{v_{\perp}T}{2\pi}\Rightarrow\dfrac{p}{r}=2\pi\cot\theta$.
$2p=2\pi r\Rightarrow p=\pi r\Rightarrow2\pi\cot\theta=\pi$.
$\therefore\ \theta=\tan^{-1}(2)$
